 Coram : Sarang V. Kotwal, J.
Date : 10th January, 2020

[In Chamber At 2:45 P.M.]
P.C.
1.

Vide order dated 6.6.2019 passed in Anticipatory Bail Application No.1044/2019, I had rejected the applicant's anticipatory bail application in connection with C.R. No.88/2019 registered with Gandhi Nagar Police Station, District-Kolhapur under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(2)(e) and 30(2)(a) of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
Till today inspite of rejection of this application, the applicant was not arrested and thereafter he has again preferred fresh anticipatory bail application vide present A.B.A. No.2611/2019.

sentences.text: 3. sentences.text: According to learned Counsel for the applicant, in the changed circumstances the applicant is now entitled for the relief of anticipatory bail.
4. Learned A.P.P. seeks time to take instructions.

5. Considering the submissions made by the learned Counsel for the applicant, his principal submission appears to be that there are changed circumstances enabling him to approach this Court again for anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of this Court in Anand Ramdhani Chaurasia (supra).

I am informed by learned Counsel for the applicant that a group of Anticipatory  2/3 Imran Iqbal Patawekar vs The Sr. Police Inspector And Anr on 10 January, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175106726/

Registry is directed to place this matter before the regular Court.
